description: This file defines the DistributionValidations class, which extends StatisticalValidations, and provides validation for probability values used in statistical distributions within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: DistributionValidations
classes.description: A class that validates probability input for statistical distributions, ensuring values are within [0, 1], extending the StatisticalValidations class.

methods.name: validateProbability
methods.description: Validates that the provided probability is a float within the range [0, 1]; throws an exception if invalid.
